method: git archaeology (git log --all --grep, git log -S, git log -L) in cm-main; cross-check vs ISSUE-OUTCOMES-r2.md and DECISIONS-r3.md / ADRs

findings.claim: r2 verdict 'needs-decision' for #1211 (analytics stats re-reads every sidecar) is wrong; v2 already closes it by design.
findings.evidence: ADR-0002 Context: 'v1 keeps separate session and content DBs ... and its stats code scans all of them (#1248, #1111)'. Decision: one context.db per project. Consequences: 'No cross-DB scans: stats read one file.' Confirmed in v1 history: commit e6864fa8 'refactor(statusline): read from SessionDB instead of per-PID sidecar JSON' (2026-05-10) already removed the per-PID sidecar read path for the statusline surface for the same root cause (persistStats() throttle + PID collision), leaving only ctx_stats itself as the remaining sidecar reader that ADR-0002's single-file model removes entirely.
findings.fix: Change #1211 verdict from needs-decision to closed-by-design (ADR-0002). Drop map-P1 'New decisions needed' item that implies the stats model is still open.

findings.claim: r2 verdict 'needs-decision' for #1182 (Pi: honor AbortSignal, Esc cancels / timeout+cancel reaching executor) is wrong; this is already a named GP contract test row, and Q8 settles the timeout/kill design.
findings.evidence: TECH-SPEC.md GP4 row: 'ctx_execute | shell/js/python, file, intent, timeoutMs, cancel | exit class; output cut is code-point safe; process tree killed; ... | #1182 #1093 #1121 #1176 ...' — #1182 is explicitly listed as a GP4 contract-test source issue. DECISIONS-r3.md Q8: 'ctx_execute has one fixed default timeout, kills the whole process tree (Windows: Job Object) and bounds the whole handler, batch included.' This is the same mechanism #1182 needs (host cancel -> executor -> kill child tree).
findings.fix: Change #1182 verdict from needs-decision to covered-by-test (GP4, backed by Q8/TECH-SPEC). Map doc's 'new decision #4' item is settled, not open.
